additiveModeTitle: Add a project branch to the original research page
additiveModeBody: P0 keeps vanilla technologies and adds this project's branch to the same HOI4 research page.
additiveModeTechnologyPath: The project technology file is exported alongside the vanilla source file; it does not replace that source file.
additiveModeGuiPath: The GUI uses a minimal same-path patch so the certified gridbox can appear on the original page.
additiveModeReplacementNote: This mode does not replace individual vanilla technologies. Replacing source definitions is a separate advanced workflow.
unavailable: The certified research surface is unavailable right now.
title: Technology tree
description: Choose a research page and year position just like the original game, then add your technology.
environmentDescription: This decides what players must install and which original research page shows your technology.
compatibilityAllPlayersBody: Every player can use it. The program handles Base and relevant DLC pages automatically.
compatibilityRequiresDLCBody: Only players with the DLC you select can use this Mod.
dlcOwnershipTitle: DLCs you own and use to preview this project
dlcOwnershipBody: This identifies the research page shown in your game. Disabling an owned DLC in the launcher does not simulate a player who does not own it.
environmentConfirmFailed: Could not identify this research environment.
environmentBlockedBody: Follow the action below before creating a research branch.
baselineMissingBody: When you confirm, the program reads the research-page layout from your Hearts of Iron IV folder and checks it against the certified HOI4 version.
sourceMissingTitle: The technology display reference is incomplete
sourceMissingBody: Check the game folder in Settings → Hearts of Iron IV installation. The program checks the research-page GUI and technology_tags before enabling branches.
sourceDriftTitle: The research source differs from a certified version
sourceDriftBody: Check the game folder in Settings → Hearts of Iron IV installation. Branch creation remains locked until the source is certified again, preventing overlapping nodes.
sourceGuiMissing: That is not a valid HOI4 game folder: interface/countrytechtreeview.gui is missing.
sourceTagsMissing: The selected folder is missing common/technology_tags/00_technology.txt.
sourceConnectFailed: Could not set the technology display reference.
sourceLayoutUnavailable: The certified research layout could not be read from your game folder. Check the game folder in Settings → Hearts of Iron IV installation and try again.
sourceCertifiedUnconfigured: No Hearts of Iron IV folder is set, so the certified HOI4 research layout cannot be read. Nothing was changed. Choose the game folder in Settings → Hearts of Iron IV installation.
sourceCertifiedFileMissing: The certified HOI4 research layout needs {path} in your Hearts of Iron IV folder, and that file is not there. Nothing was changed. Verify the game files in Steam, or choose a complete installation in Settings → Hearts of Iron IV installation.
sourceCertifiedVersionMismatch: Your game's {path} is from {serverVersion}, but the certified research layout was built from {expectedVersion}. Using it would leave your research page mixing two game versions, so nothing was changed. Choose a {expectedVersion} installation in Settings → Hearts of Iron IV installation.
sourceCertifiedContentMismatch: Your game reports HOI4 {reportedVersion}, but the contents of {path} do not match the audited copy (yours {serverSha}, expected {expectedSha}). The game files are mixed-version or modified, so nothing was changed. Verify the game files in Steam, or choose a clean installation in Settings → Hearts of Iron IV installation.
sourceCertifiedUnavailable: The certified HOI4 research layout could not be read from your game folder just now, and nothing was changed. Try again; if it keeps failing, check the game folder in Settings.
sourceProjectTitle: Using this Mod's technology display reference
sourceProjectBody: This project imported its own technology GUI or tags, so the Mod's content remains authoritative.
environmentUnconfirmedTitle: Choose whether this Mod requires DLC
environmentUnconfirmedBody: The program uses the latest supported HOI4 rules and reads the research pages from your game folder when you save.
environmentReadyBody: You can now choose a page and year position just like the original game.
chooseTargetDescription: Choose a page above, then select a technology position. Years and connections follow the original layout automatically.
targetUncertified: This position is not available yet.
targetRequiresDLCPolicy: Set the Mod to “Requires DLC” to use this position.
targetUnavailable: No target is available for this entrance in the identified environment.
baselineRequired: Set the technology display reference before adding a visible extension branch.
saveFailed: Could not save the certified research branch.
legacyRepairRequired: This branch was created before the fixed native timeline. Repair it explicitly before export so its nodes cannot overlap.
legacyRepairComplete: Repaired {count} branch technologies to their certified timeline.
slotUsed: Your technology is already in this position.
branchDialogDescription: Add it to {entrance} → {target}. Its position and connections are arranged automatically.
descriptionRequired: An English description is required so the game never shows a raw _desc key.
fixedSlot: The certified {area} profile assigns this node to the {year} research year and its fixed grid cell.
fixedTimeline: The selected target assigns this node to the {year} research year. Placement is automatic.
technologyDialogDescription: Choose its preceding technology. The visual path and next grid cell are assigned automatically.
automaticPlacement: This technology will use the {year} position.
requiredDLCsBody: Select only the DLCs this Mod actually depends on.
latestVersionReady: Configured for the latest supported HOI4 version
targetFirstYear: The first technology will use the {year} position
yearComesFromPosition: The year comes from the original tree position you selected. Placement and connections stay aligned automatically.
technicalSettingsBody: The program generates stable IDs automatically. Change them only when another script must reference a specific ID.
deleteBranchBody: This deletes “{name}” and its {count} technologies. This cannot be undone.
